A: Existing prompt, including: Accept equivalent mathematics, not keyword overlap.
B: Replace only that sentence with: Judge each rubric obligation at its stated strength, accepting equivalent ways to satisfy it. Do not treat a preferred method, a stronger guarantee, or an optional improvement as an additional obligation.
controls: New synthetic nullspace, numerical residual and Lipschitz quadrature documents: three valid alternative certificates, two false-assertion controls, and one honest partial certificate. No statistical research task, UCB content, old reference, old qualification or old judgment is reused. Expected labels and prior assessments are hidden from each independent session.
fixed_parameters: Same complete files, tools, schema, retained loop, model, thinking and budgets. Both conditions use the existing request constructor; fingerprints and stored sessions reflect the actual prompt. The private predeclared order is shuffled before any calls. No product code is edited to run the study.
decision_rule: Do not ship a prompt change unless B makes fewer expected-label errors than A, accepts no false-assertion control, keeps the partial control unresolved, and loses no valid acceptance from A. A tie is no demonstrated improvement. No outcome-driven prompt revision or repeat.
evidence_boundary: A small component study, not full paired authority qualification, mathematical proof, a product draw, research-E2E capability or task activation. Even a favorable result does not qualify an authority or permit replay of any consumed evaluation. No additional judge, scheduler, repair policy or case-specific runtime rule is introduced.
